description: All four agents plus the orchestrator: Agent 1 (Document Investigator, LLM), Agent 2 (Cross-Checker, deterministic), Agent 3 (Climate Analyst, deterministic), Agent 4 (Auditor, LLM + guardrails), status-policy, orchestrator, and the analyze/report API routes. Also creates all five vitest test files. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create src/lib/agents/schemas.ts with ALL zod schemas exactly as defined in design.md: DocumentExtraction (z.object with document_type enum, issuer, supplier_name, certificate_id, issue_date, expiry_date, batch_ids, quantities array, claims array, is_demo_marked, missing_fields, uncertainties), Finding (finding_id, rule_id, result enum PASS/FLAG/UNKNOWN, severity enum low/medium/high, finding, reason, evidence_ids, claim_type nullable), ActivityData (period_start, period_end, production_units nullable, lines array with id/kind/quantity/unit/quality/source_doc_id), CarbonResult (completeness enum, factor_status enum, boundary, lines array, total_kgco2e nullable, kgco2e_per_unit nullable, assumptions, limitations), AuditReport (summary, claims array, statements array with cites, next_actions array, recommendation enum APPROVE/REQUEST_EVIDENCE/REJECT). Export all schemas and their inferred TypeScript types.

Create src/lib/llm/gemini.ts: import { GoogleGenerativeAI } from '@google/genai'; import env from src/lib/env.ts. Export async function generateJson<T>(systemPrompt: string, userPrompt: string, schema: z.ZodType<T>): Promise<T>. Use env.GEMINI_MODEL, temperature 0, responseMimeType 'application/json'. Parse response text as JSON, validate with schema.parse(). On ZodError: retry once appending the validation error message to the user prompt. On second failure: throw error with code LLM_UNAVAILABLE. Map network/API errors to LLM_UNAVAILABLE. Never log API keys.

Create src/lib/agents/document-investigator.ts: export async function investigateDocument(buffer: Buffer, mimeType: string, filename: string, batchCode: string): Promise<DocumentExtraction>. Steps: (1) call extractText(buffer, mimeType); (2) if !hasText return a DocumentExtraction with all nulls, document_type='other', missing_fields=['all'], and a note in uncertainties; (3) call generateJson with SYSTEM_PROMPT and USER_PROMPT constants (copy verbatim from docs/AGENT_SPECS.md Agent 1 section — the <document> wrapper, batch context line, etc.); (4) validate result with DocumentExtraction schema (gemini.ts handles retry); (5) on failure throw with code EXTRACTION_FAILED.

Create src/lib/agents/cross-checker.ts: export function runChecks(batch: BatchWithClaims, extractions: DocumentExtraction[], now: Date): Finding[]. Implement ALL 8 rules from design.md exactly: CERTIFICATE_DATE_VALIDITY (FLAG high if cert expiry < production_date or cert issue > production_date; UNKNOWN if no cert or dates null), CERTIFICATE_NOT_EXPIRED_NOW (FLAG medium if expiry < now; UNKNOWN if expiry null), SUPPLIER_NAME_MATCH (normalise names per AGENT_SPECS.md helper; FLAG medium if no doc supplier matches batch supplier; UNKNOWN if no supplier on any doc), BATCH_ID_MATCH (FLAG high if doc lists batch_ids and none equals batch_code; UNKNOWN if no doc lists batch_ids), RECYCLED_CONTENT_VALUE_MATCH (for declared recycled_content: FLAG high if cert/composition value differs ±0.5; PASS if matches; UNKNOWN if no document gives a recycled %), QUANTITY_CONSISTENCY (compare same-unit same-label quantities across invoice/declaration; FLAG medium if differ >2%; UNKNOWN if fewer than 2 comparable quantities), REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_PRESENT (per claim check config/evidence-requirements.json; FLAG high for each missing doc type; always decidable — no UNKNOWN), ENERGY_DATA_PRESENT (for low_carbon_manufacturing: PASS if activity data has electricity kWh>0 and energy_report exists; else FLAG high). Finding ids: rule_id + ':' + index. normalise helper: lowercase, remove punctuation, drop tokens ltd/limited/pvt/private/inc/llc/co/company, collapse spaces.

Create src/lib/agents/climate-analyst.ts: export function computeCarbon(activity: ActivityData, factorsJson: typeof import('../../config/emission-factors.json')): CarbonResult. Algorithm exactly per docs/AGENT_SPECS.md Agent 3 section: (1) build factor index by kind; (2) for each line: if quantity null or quality=missing -> kgco2e=null, add limitation; (3) check unit against factor unit, apply unit_conversions table (MWh->kWh *1000 only; L is the diesel factor unit — no conversion needed); if no conversion exists -> kgco2e=null, limitation 'unit mismatch for <kind>'; (4) kgco2e = quantity * factor.value; (5) completeness: INSUFFICIENT if no electricity line computed; COMPLETE if all lines computed; else PARTIAL; (6) total = sum computed or null; kgco2e_per_unit = total/production_units when both non-null; (7) factor_status = ILLUSTRATIVE_FACTORS if any used factor verified:false; (8) boundary constant per AGENT_SPECS.md; (9) assumptions list factor ids and sources. Round to 2dp at output only.

Create src/lib/agents/status-policy.ts: export const RANK: Record<'APPROVE'|'REQUEST_EVIDENCE'|'REJECT', number> = { APPROVE: 2, REQUEST_EVIDENCE: 1, REJECT: 0 }; export function clamp(llm: Rec, ceiling: Rec): Rec { return RANK[llm] <= RANK[ceiling] ? llm : ceiling; }; export function deriveCeiling(findings: Finding[], carbon: CarbonResult, claims: string[]): Rec — implement 4 rules from design.md: (1) any FLAG high on CERTIFICATE_DATE_VALIDITY, BATCH_ID_MATCH, or direct value mismatch (RECYCLED_CONTENT_VALUE_MATCH) -> REQUEST_EVIDENCE; (2) any UNKNOWN/FLAG on REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_PRESENT or ENERGY_DATA_PRESENT for a declared claim -> REQUEST_EVIDENCE; (3) carbon INSUFFICIENT with declared low_carbon_manufacturing -> REQUEST_EVIDENCE; (4) else APPROVE.

Create src/lib/agents/auditor.ts: export async function runAuditor(findings: Finding[], carbon: CarbonResult, claims: BatchClaim[], ceiling: Rec): Promise<AuditReport>. (1) Build input JSON; (2) call generateJson with AUDITOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT and user prompt 'Report input:\n{json}' (copy prompts verbatim from docs/AGENT_SPECS.md Agent 4 section); (3) if LLM fails twice: build fallback report (summary = 'Automated narrative unavailable. ' + counts PASS/FLAG/UNKNOWN, statements = one per FLAG/UNKNOWN citing its finding_id, recommendation = ceiling); (4) post-processing: (a) drop statements with empty cites or cites containing ids not in findings set (except literal 'LIMITATION'); (b) recommendation = clamp(llm.recommendation, ceiling); (c) for each declared claim, if any FLAG on REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_PRESENT -> force status UNSUPPORTED; if FLAG on RECYCLED_CONTENT_VALUE_MATCH -> force CONTRADICTED; (d) never output 'VERIFIED' in claim statuses.

Create src/lib/agents/orchestrator.ts: export async function runPipeline(batchId: string): Promise<{ runId: string; status: 'COMPLETED' | 'FAILED' }>. Steps: (1) load batch row including claims, activity_data, previous status; (2) check for existing RUNNING run (one_running_run_per_batch index) -> throw RUN_IN_PROGRESS; (3) check evidence_documents count > 0 -> else throw NO_EVIDENCE; (4) appendAudit(batchId, 'run_started'); (5) insert verification_runs row with status RUNNING, run_number = (max existing + 1 or 1); (6) set batch status ANALYZING; (7) for each evidence doc: download from storage, call investigateDocument, update evidence_documents.extraction_status and extracted_data; (8) call runChecks(batch, extractions, new Date()); (9) call computeCarbon(activity_data, emissionFactors); (10) call deriveCeiling(findings, carbonResult, claims); (11) call runAuditor(findings, carbonResult, claims, ceiling); (12) update verification_runs: status=COMPLETED, findings, carbon_result, audit_report, recommendation_ceiling, ai_recommendation, completed_at=now(); (13) set batch status IN_REVIEW; (14) appendAudit('run_completed'). On any throw at steps 7-13: update run status=FAILED, set error_code, restore batch to previous status, appendAudit('run_failed'). Return { runId, status }.

Create src/app/api/batches/[id]/analyze/route.ts with POST: call runPipeline(id); return { runId, status } on success; map RUN_IN_PROGRESS and NO_EVIDENCE to 409/400 respectively. Set export const maxDuration = 60.
Create src/app/api/batches/[id]/report/route.ts with GET: load latest verification_run for batchId including all agent results; return run data for UI polling.

Create tests/cross-checker.test.ts: vitest tests for ALL 8 rules. Each rule must have at least one PASS case, one FLAG case, one UNKNOWN case (where applicable). Plus one determinism test: call runChecks twice with identical inputs and assert deep-equal results. Use synthetic batch/extraction objects — do not read from sample-data files.

Create tests/climate-analyst.test.ts: (1) complete case — all lines present, all electricity, diesel, natural_gas with correct units -> COMPLETE, verify kgco2e per line and total; (2) missing electricity -> INSUFFICIENT; (3) unit mismatch (e.g. 'gallons' for electricity) -> kgco2e=null for that line, limitation text present; (4) ILLUSTRATIVE_FACTORS label present when any factor verified:false (always true with current config).

Create tests/status-policy.test.ts: test deriveCeiling for all 4 ceiling rules triggering REQUEST_EVIDENCE, and the APPROVE case. Test clamp: llm=APPROVE with ceiling=REQUEST_EVIDENCE -> REQUEST_EVIDENCE; llm=REJECT with ceiling=APPROVE -> REJECT (no upgrade).

Create tests/auditor-postprocess.test.ts: mock generateJson to return a fake AuditReport with (a) a statement whose cites reference a nonexistent finding_id, and (b) recommendation=APPROVE when ceiling=REQUEST_EVIDENCE. Assert: the uncited statement is dropped from the final report; the recommendation is clamped to REQUEST_EVIDENCE. Also test fallback report structure when LLM fails twice.

Update src/app/batches/[id]/page.tsx to add the 'Run analysis' button calling POST /api/batches/:id/analyze, then polling /api/batches/:id/report every 2 seconds until status is COMPLETED or FAILED. Show loading spinner during ANALYZING. On COMPLETED render findings grouped by category (PASS->Verified-by-check, FLAG->Inconsistent, UNKNOWN on REQUIRED_EVIDENCE->Missing, other UNKNOWN->Unverified). Create src/components/FindingCard.tsx: shows rule_id, severity badge (high=red/medium=yellow/low=blue), finding text, evidence_ids list, reason. Create src/components/CarbonPanel.tsx: table of emission lines (kind, quantity, unit, factor_id, factor_value, factor_source, kgco2e), total kgco2e, kgco2e_per_unit, ILLUSTRATIVE_FACTORS warning banner when factor_status=ILLUSTRATIVE_FACTORS, boundary statement, assumptions list, all with units displayed.
Run npx vitest run and npm run build — all tests must pass, build must succeed.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run — tests/cross-checker.test.ts, tests/climate-analyst.test.ts, tests/status-policy.test.ts, tests/auditor-postprocess.test.ts all pass with 0 failures
runChecks with identical inputs returns deep-equal results (determinism)
computeCarbon with missing electricity line returns completeness=INSUFFICIENT
deriveCeiling returns REQUEST_EVIDENCE for any high-severity FLAG on CERTIFICATE_DATE_VALIDITY
Auditor post-processing drops statements with no valid cites
Auditor recommendation is clamped to ceiling when LLM returns higher recommendation
findings: 1) @google/genai v1.3.0 exports GoogleGenAI (not GoogleGenerativeAI); updated gemini.ts to use the new client.models.generateContent({ model, contents, config }) API. 2) ActivityData stub schema in schemas.ts replaced with the full design.md schema; backward-compat alias activityDataSchema kept for FEAT-002 activity route. 3) Cross-checker REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_PRESENT rule generates one finding per (claim, required_doc_type) pair so finding_ids remain stable within a run. 4) Climate analyst uses empty activity_data (no lines) when batch has no activity_data, returning INSUFFICIENT completeness.
